item.title: Armed forces ready to help a free, fair election: Army Chief
item.description: CHATTOGRAM, Jan 22: Bangladesh Army chief General Waker-Uz-Zaman has said the armed forces will provide all-out support to ensure a free, fair, and peaceful election.He made the remarks at a discussion on the February general election at the Chattogram Circuit House on Thursday afternoon.An announcement about the meeting was published on the official Facebook page of the Chattogram District Administration at 3pm.The Chattogram deputy commissioner's Staff Officer and Assistant Commissioner Md Moy

item.title: BD rejects ICC decision, refuses to travel to India
item.description: Bangladesh sticks to its decision not to travel to India for next month's Twenty20 World Cup, escalating a standoff with the International Cricket Council (ICC).Bangladesh Cricket Board (BCB) president Aminul Islam Bulbul said on Thursday that Bangladesh wanted to play the World Cup but only if their fixtures were moved out of India to Sri Lanks. item.title: China rules out US envoy's remarks on ties with BD
item.description: China has said on Thursday that the cooperation between Bangladesh and China is a matter between the two countries and their peoples, and brooks no interference or finger-pointing from the US side.China on Thursday reacted to China-related remarks by the US Ambassador to Bangladesh, urging the US side "to be more aware of its responsibilities and focus more on actions" that are "conducive to Bangladesh's stability," as well as to development and cooperation in the region, according to a reaction

item.title: Feb 12 elections to set standard for future votes, CA tells US ambassador

item.title: BNP leader shot in Keraniganj
item.description: A local BNP leader was injured in a gun attack by miscreants in the capital’s Keraniganj on Thursday night.The victim was identified as Hasan Mollah, 45, son of Akar Mollah of Jagannathpur village under Keraniganj thana. item.title: Tarique Rahman urges BNP activists to stay alert against vote rigging
item.description: BNP Chairman Tarique Rahman called on party leaders and activists to remain vigilant to counter conspiracies and prevent vote rigging in the upcoming 13th national parliamentary elections.He made the remarks while speaking as the chief guest in an election rally at Kuttapara Mini Stadium in Sarail upazila of Brahmanbaria district on Thursday.In his speech, Tarique Rahman said he was delayed in reaching the venue due to large crowds of leaders and activists along the route from Sylhet. item.title: ‘Every voter to perform Tahajjud prayers and go to polling centres’
item.description: BNP Chairperson Tarique Rahman urged voters to go to polling centres after performing Tahajjud prayers to ensure their voting rights in the upcoming national election.“On February 12, everyone must go to the polling centres to restore voting rights. item.title: Tarique Rahman raises alarm over postal ballot rigging ahead of polls
item.description: BNP Chairperson Tarique Rahman alleged that old conspiracies surrounding elections have resurfaced and warned voters to remain alert over attempts to manipulate expatriates’ postal ballots.He made the remarks while addressing a late-night rally at the Pachrukhhi Anwara Degree College ground at Araihazar upazila in Narayanganj district.The rally was held in the early hours of Friday, with Tarique Rahman speaking at around 4:00 AM after launching his campaign journey from Sylhet.Calling on voters

item.title: Two killed, 10 injured as mini-bus overturns in Mymensingh
